title: Settings
subtitle: Your account, apps and playback preferences

password.title: Password
password.same: The new password must be different.
password.footer: You stay signed in on this device. Subsonic apps that sign in with your password need the new one.

subsonic.title: Subsonic apps
subsonic.description: Listen with any Subsonic / OpenSubsonic compatible app.
subsonic.keyNone: No API key yet. Apps that support API keys never see your password.
subsonic.copyNow: Copy your API key now — it won't be shown again.
subsonic.invalidateWarning: Apps using the current key will stop working until you enter a new one.
subsonic.passwordNote: Apps without API key support can sign in with your username and password instead.
subsonic.clientsHint: Enter the server address, then your username and password or API key.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentHint: Used for buttons, highlights and progress.
appearance.albumColorsHint: Album, playlist and artist pages take on the colours of their artwork.

playback.title: Playback
playback.qualityOriginalHint: Plays your files as they are. Formats this browser can't play are converted automatically.
playback.qualityHint: Up to this bit rate (kbps), about {{mb}} MB per hour. Higher-quality files are converted on the fly.
playback.formatHint: Used whenever a song is converted. Opus sounds best at low bit rates; AAC and MP3 play everywhere.
playback.opusUnsupported: This browser can't play Opus, so AAC or MP3 is used instead.
playback.replayGainHint: Uses ReplayGain tags to even out loudness between songs or albums.
playback.replayGainUnsupported: Not available on this device — the system controls the volume.
playback.preloadHint: Buffers the next song before the current one ends for near-gapless playback.
playback.preloadUnsupported: Not available on iPhone and iPad.
playback.lyricsTranslationHint: Shows the translation under each line of bilingual lyrics.
playback.footer: Playback settings are saved on this device only.

install.title: App
install.label: Install Rainy
install.hint: Add Rainy to your home screen or dock for a full-screen app experience.

scrobbling.title: Scrobbling
scrobbling.description: Send what you play, in Rainy and in your Subsonic apps, to Last.fm or ListenBrainz.
scrobbling.footer: A song counts once you have played half of it or 4 minutes. Plays wait on the server while a service is unreachable and are sent later; plays older than 14 days are no longer accepted. If a Subsonic app scrobbles to Last.fm by itself, turn that off in the app to avoid double scrobbles.
scrobbling.unavailable: Your administrator has not turned on {{service}}.
scrobbling.turnedOff: Your administrator turned {{service}} off; nothing is sent.
scrobbling.needsRelink: {{service}} no longer accepts this connection. Connect again.

lastfm.help: Sign in on Last.fm and allow Rainy to scrobble. Starring a song also loves it on Last.fm.
lastfm.unlinkDescription: Rainy forgets the connection and the plays still waiting. To revoke Rainy's access completely, also remove it under Applications in your Last.fm settings.

listenbrainz.help: Paste the user token from your ListenBrainz settings page.
listenbrainz.unlinkDescription: Rainy forgets your token and the plays still waiting. To revoke it completely, reset the token in your ListenBrainz settings.

scrobbling.callbackDeniedHint: The sign-in was cancelled or did not finish. You can start it again from Settings.

mascot.title: Mascot
mascot.intro: Rainy’s mascot keeps you company on empty pages, errors and the sign-in screen, and listens along from the corner.
mascot.artHint: Show the mascot on empty, error and sign-in screens.
mascot.companionHint: Show her in the bottom-right corner on tablets and desktops. She reacts to playback.
